people.name: Benjamin_Gate
people.line: Gate in Jerusalem, associated with the tribe of Benjamin.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Pashhur
people.line: Priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib

translations.web: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: Then Pashhur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Jehovah.
